scope: Existing OpenFolk operator Phone and email account-health reads for Drummonds

phoneReader.release: TEST synthetic fixture and rollback rehearsal, TEST install, LIVE rollback rehearsal, LIVE install all verified; original owner and restricted execute ACL retained.
phoneReader.resultParity: The proposed SQL returned byte-equivalent JSON for the actual LIVE Phone account and an absent-account case before release. Existing TEST settlement, refusal, replay, mismatch, role and rollback assertions passed against the replacement.
phoneReader.warmPlanBefore: 204.215 ms, 91,516 shared buffer hits; the latest and last-confirmed branches scanned 15,444 and 14,505 Phone runs respectively.
phoneReader.warmPlanAfter: 15.601 ms, 3,443 shared buffer hits; latest Phone lookup returned one indexed run and settlement-guided lookup used 756 primary-key probes. The exact confirmation checks remain in place.

emailLookup.release: TEST and LIVE rollback rehearsals and installations verified; index valid and ready; reader definitions, ownership and grants unchanged.
emailLookup.before: Existing index examined about 548 irrelevant runs per mailbox in a measured 30-mailbox plan; a full account read took 4,783.575 ms and read 9,236 blocks after the Phone release.
emailLookup.after: LIVE plan selected learn_email_health_latest_runs_idx, returned one terminal run per mailbox without the irrelevant scan, and the full account read took 819.889 ms with 1,314 read blocks. These are observations under differing cache/load states, not a guaranteed latency bound.

signedInLiveAcceptance.operator: Existing authorised OpenFolk owner selected Drummond Heating.
signedInLiveAcceptance.freshReload: Capture account page, separate company totals and scheduling list loaded on a new browser navigation without an unavailable-state message.
